vectors.flow: Wallet -> Governance -> Timelock -> Canary -> Chain -> Explorer
happyPath: Wallet/Auth proves the exact governance Product Session and device
an eligible signed proposal and vote reach the approved state
the exact action survives timelock and signed canary checks
Chain Core commits the execution intent
Governance verifies the exact receipt and Explorer indexes it
negativeCases: wrong product, device, scope, expiry or revoked session is rejected before mutation
out-of-bounds parameter or changed ActionHash is rejected
early, expired, duplicate or failed-canary execution is rejected
receipt, manifest, block, state-root or audit mismatch is rejected
requiredEvidence: proposal, vote, timelock and canary audit records
Explorer lookup and Monitor alert state

vectors.flow: Emergency -> Expiry -> Follow-up Vote -> Trust Transparency
happyPath: a scoped council threshold creates a temporary emergency action
the pause applies only to the approved target and maximum duration
the mandatory follow-up proposal and Trust transparency record remain public
negativeCases: asset transfer, arbitrary mint or mandate restoration is rejected
single-member or wrong-scope approval is rejected
duration widening and hidden closure are rejected

happyPath: the proposal binds source, release, manifest, migration and rollback
the signed canary reports a threshold failure
rollback evidence is verified and archived
negativeCases: duplicate manifest or active-scope conflict is rejected
unsigned or wrong-manifest canary result is rejected
